title: inventory.container_nested
description: M6B § ItemSpec canonicalization — fired when an item is nested inside a container in the inventory grid. The depth field carries the resulting nesting depth (1 = top-level container, 2 = nested container, capped by MAX_CONTAINER_NEST_DEPTH). Rejections (depth > 2) fire actor.action_rejected with reason 'max_depth_exceeded' instead of this event. Additive-only per M4 DR-002.
